adversarial_questions.question: Does this operator silently convert the Walter-Heimann provenance fingerprint into historical ANIMO truth?
adversarial_questions.basis: The contract is explicitly MODEL_EVOLUTION_SCIENTIFIC_CONTRACT and keeps the historical revision-53 selector unresolved.

adversarial_questions.question: Could the existing root-index selector Te(Nuroup+1) remain an equivalent fallback?
adversarial_questions.basis: Nuroup is crop/root state rather than physical depth; the v1 contract forbids fallback to root-index, Te(0), Te(1), nearest-layer or containing-layer semantics.

adversarial_questions.question: Is linear interpolation merely an arbitrary aesthetic choice?
adversarial_questions.basis: Between adjacent layer-centre samples it is the local node-preserving affine-exact reconstruction. This supports a bounded new design but does not claim historical use or empirical superiority over all alternatives.

adversarial_questions.question: Does the operator invent unavailable surface or bottom temperature information?
adversarial_questions.basis: Targets outside the first-to-last layer-centre bracket return UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED even if 0.50 m lies inside a physical boundary half-cell. No extrapolation is authorized.

adversarial_questions.question: Does GHG06A redefine temporal averaging of the Te field?
adversarial_questions.basis: GHG06A qualifies the spatial fixed-depth reconstruction over the current Te field. The provider's existing time-coordinate and temperature semantics are inherited; no new temporal averaging operator is introduced.

adversarial_questions.question: Can synthetic affine and interpolation oracles be treated as historical B2 behavior?
adversarial_questions.basis: They are explicitly synthetic model-evolution oracles and test only the new mathematical contract.

adversarial_questions.question: Does this qualification close active plant-mediated methane behavior?
adversarial_questions.basis: FvegCH4>0 positive activation remains a separate GHG07 scope; no production or B3 admission follows automatically.

residual_limits: v1 is unavailable when 0.50 m is not bracketed by layer centres
